numbers._note: M8 step 1b (docs/DESIGN.md, 'World generation, details'; the user's decisions 2026-10-24, the exact numbers my picks, to confirm): dead_share, the dice for a dead mound (real surveys: a third to a half of mounds dead; 0.5 since BUGS 104, as a Matabele dead mound with no living mound near lives, leaving about a quarter dead); living_stages, bands of mound stage (1 to 32) and their weights for living colonies (the user's table 2026-10-24: giant cathedrals rare, most mounds small; stages 1 to 3 never, a first-year colony has no mound to see; the colony's workers and age follow its stage); dead_sizes, the same for the size a dead mound had stood to (tilted bigger: big mounds stand for decades, small dead ones wash away fast); dead_stages, weights of freshly dead (0-3 days), wearing (3-12), slumping (12-30) and old grassy humps (35-200); hump_woods, of the old humps how many have trees or a thicket on them (real mound islands); aardvark_burrows, of the old humps how many an aardvark has dug a burrow into, down to the old nest (0 turns it off); hump_grass, greener grass on the old humps (false turns it off).

places._note: M8 step 3F, F1 (worldgen/MoundPlaces; the user's decisions 2026-11-04, the numbers my picks, to confirm): every chunk offers a candidate place with its own territory, territory_min to territory_max blocks (its size: big territories hold big mounds); two places stand at least their two territories apart, so mounds land about 42 to 82 blocks apart, mostly round 60. A place holds a mound by the ground's chance: ground_chance on flat dry ground, slope_cut of it lost on the steepest ground a mound takes (max_uneven blocks up and down 8 blocks round the middle; 6 since BUGS 104, was 4), water_cut lost with water within water_look blocks; never in water, on a steep slope or outside a savanna. In Minecraft's rolling savanna that is about 1 place in 3 (BUGS 104; the 2 in 3 first planned was a flat-ground guess), so mounds stand about 60 to 100 apart. Next to each empty place within lean_reach a mound leans bigger (its size quantile's rest times empty_lean). A dead mound whose dice give it Matabele lives instead when no mound living by the dice stands within 70 blocks (BUGS 104: the Matabele settle only among the termites they raid), so dead_share is the dice (0.5), about a quarter of the mounds ending dead.
